Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/27518" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "ui 席 1" one message with your branch name and wait. Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…}]`, draft forced, ⛔ no `assignees` and ⛔ no review request: the seat hands the PR to a person after its ACCEPT; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27518 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`; first line the signature `domain:ui#1 · os-sales · <your session>`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的), `Fixes #27518`, `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:` lines as in the claim. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` named `27518-<slug>.md` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Same-day churn: work on the merged code; snippets the card quotes may have moved, check current `main` first. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "ui 席 1" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

No maintainer ruling on this card. Triage direction (comment 6495106294), verbatim: 「Reuse the existing dataset metadata type and its draft/publish door. The empty-state copy names where to create one. No second report data source.」 and 「The lane designs the dataset authoring entry, and it is not a decision card. If it adds an authorable key, it owes `Clause-②` and a contract review.」

### PM mechanism assumptions (measured read-only on `origin/main` `57c51aab4d`; re-measure)

- The Report create dialog `ReportCreateFields` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/interfaceCreate.tsx` ~297–370) and the dashboard widget picker (`metadata-admin/inspectors/DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx` ~113–150 via `dataset-picker-options.ts`) both offer only `useDatasetCatalog` (`metadata-admin/previews/useDatasetCatalog.ts` ~163, `client.list('dataset')`); `noDatasets` shows only on an empty catalog (`interfaceCreate.tsx` ~332–336).
- Studio has no dataset surface (no `dataset` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `packageSurfaces.ts`, `CreateItemDialog.tsx`, `StudioRail.tsx`); no auto-derive code exists. Reusable pieces exist outside Studio: `DatasetDefaultInspector`, `DatasetPreview`, `dataset` in `CREATE_MODE_CANVAS_TYPES` (`ResourceEditPage.tsx` ~250).

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

- A visible "New dataset" path in Studio that creates a `dataset` item in the current package through the existing dataset metadata type and the same draft/publish door the other Studio items use, opened from both pickers (and from Studio's create flow if that is where items are created), with the object preselected when the picker knows it; after create, the picker selects the new dataset.
- The pickers show the package's own datasets first; the empty-state copy says where to create one and is shown whenever no dataset reads one of the package's objects, not only when the catalog is empty.
- Auto-derived per-object datasets would be a new capability (startup no-spread axis). If you measure that the "New dataset" path cannot work on the existing type and door, stop and report `needs_decision` with options and a recommendation analysed on the four axes below — ⛔ do not build auto datasets on your own.

### Four-axis frame (SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉, copied verbatim at commit `57c51aab4d`, md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`)

**每个方案必须沿四条固定评估轴分析,这是决策分析的核心原则,不是可选项:**

- **实际业务需求** — 它服务的是**真实存在的业务场景**,
  还是投机性能力面?判据要求**实测**(谁在写这个键、谁在读、
  示例应用与真实部署的用法),「读起来像有用」不作数。这条轴会改变结论,不是陪衬。
- **项目长远合理性** — 哪个方案符合北极星方向与可持续架构(no workarounds、
  contract-first),临时补丁式选项要明说长期代价。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错,尤其是防 AI 写元数据 app 犯错** — 哪个方案让 AI 在结构上*更难写错*:
  契约收紧(严格 schema、publish 时响亮拒绝)优于消费端宽容(`??` 回退、静默容错)——
  宽容恰是 AI 批量犯错被掩盖的温床;声明即强制,绝不让 AI 声明一个运行时不兑现的能力。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — **创业阶段聚焦原则**:创业项目先专注核心能力,能力扩张默认
  从紧,无拉动的声明面按 implementation-first 处置,已发布零消费能力不因沉没成本豁免。
  **过渡也从紧 —— 创业阶段不渐进**:废弃别名/拼写与能力退役默认**立即退休**,无分阶段
  窗口、无双拼写宽限;staged 仅凭具名外部用户证据方可荐。**新增门禁默认否**:门禁是只减
  不增的零件,例外只有维护者点名;荐新增门禁须引其点名原话,否则荐「不加」。

**基本裁决原则**:spec 声明 > 实现 > 文档面;声明而未兑现是实现缺口,补实现或退役,
⛔ 不在消费端收窄;未声明键随实现,文档随之。「声明即强制」只及 spec 与元数据契约、
运行时能力,⛔ 不及 AGENTS.md 这类给 agent 读的约定 —— 那些的读者是 agent,不是门禁。
推荐意见必须基于这四条轴给出理由;四轴冲突时如实呈现权衡,
交维护者拍板。

### Scope

- File surface: the files above, `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` / `zh.ts` (and the other packs for new keys), tests beside, changeset. ⛔ `packages/spec/**`: a new authorable key is not expected; if one turns out necessary, stop and report it (spec lane).
- Acceptance: on a fresh `examples/app-showcase` boot, an admin creates a package object, opens Report → Dataset and Add widget → Bar chart → Dataset, finds a way to create a dataset over that object, and ends with a report and a chart on it (screenshots in the PR body); tests for the picker entry, the empty-state condition, and the post-create selection.
- Studio neighbours in flight: #27458 and #27464 (in-seat, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx`, `AppNavCanvas.tsx` / `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) share only the studio i18n namespace; PR #27533 and #27340 edit `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` / `DatasetPreview.tsx` — merge `main` for conflicts only.
- Tier: no path-derived mandate ⇒ `TIER_DEFAULT`; effort `xhigh` (p1, L). `Clause-②: no` (unless an authorable key appears — then stop, see above). `Metadata-protocol: none`.
